build_graph_attention_data: build a GraphAttentionData object from AtomicData using biknn radius graph and edge expansions
create_edge_distance_expansion: create Gaussian or Sigmoid smearing edge distance expansion features for molecular graph edges
compute_frequency_vectors: compute spherical harmonics frequency vectors for neighbor attention from edge direction tensors
calculate_bond_orientational_order: calculate Bond-Orientational Order features for each node using spherical harmonics and neighbor masks
pad_and_unpad_batch: pad a batch of molecular graphs to fixed size for torch.compile and unpad results after inference
